headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty recovered in midday trade supported by banking and IT stocks.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: The Indian stock market is closed today, 22 November 2026, as it is a weekend.
In the last trading session on 20 November, early market weakness was caused by a sell-off in global AI stocks.
Midday recovery on Friday was driven by support from banking and IT stocks.
Federal Reserve signals of potential rate hikes added pressure to market sentiment earlier in the week.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty recovered from early losses on 20 November with support from IT and banking sectors.
Earlier in the week, Sensex surged nearly 1,000 points led by auto and banking stocks after initial declines.
Upcoming IPOs in the coming week include Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries and Foodlink F&B.
Key dividend stocks in focus for the week include Vraj Iron And Steel and Pashupati Cotspin.
summary: The Indian stock market is closed today, 22 November 2026, due to the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 23 November. On the last trading session, Indian indices recovered midday from early global AI sell-off pressure, buoyed by IT and banking stocks. Investors remain focused on upcoming IPOs and dividend-paying stocks in the week ahead.
